positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Transmission Controls Calibration Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop transmission clutch control strategies and calibrations to optimize shift quality, performance, and robustness across all conditions and variations.
- Perform system integration analysis and debugging to achieve desired hardware and software performance.
- Create software tools in python to perform shift-data analytics, generate optimal calibrations, and provide visualization of complex data. 
- Automate complex testing procedures to produce consistent, reliable data and reduce testing time across all users.
- Collaborate with software engineers to develop new control algorithms and root cause implementation issues.

positions.title: Labview Programmer
positions.description:
- Developed a LabVIEW application designed to integrate testing, data acquisition, and 
operation control on multiple hardware devices simultaneously. 
- Designed a publish-subscribe framework to create a communication scheme allowing for modular plugins with decoupled messaging.
- Developed the hardware device plugin framework using object-oriented programming

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Modified a CAD CAMS’s G-code command preprocessor to output the correct commands for a 3-axis Hurco CNC, correcting costly errors during operation.
- Designed a mechanical release mechanism for an underwater deployment vessel using SolidWorks.
- Developed a post-process procedure utilizing various epoxies to strengthen 3D-printed parts against extreme hydrostatic pressure.

courses.name: Directed Group Studies for Advanced Undergraduates

projects.title: Python ASAM A2L Parser
projects.description: Python A2L Parser reads an ASAM standard A2L file and converts the content into usable python objects accessed through dictionary lookups. The core functionality is written utilizing C, Flex, and Bison. The C code is full functional and stores the data in appropriate structures. Current development is in wrapping the C code within Python for ease of use.

projects.title: ASAM MDF3 Python Library
projects.description: The MDF3 python library takes ASAM standard MD3 files and extracts the recorded data signals into usable python (signal) objects to be used in post-processing analytics. The primary purpose for writing this library was to learn python and develop a MDF3 parsing library that didn't require compiling due to cython utilization.
